title: Pilot: Tiered Observability Credits with Conditional Compliance Escrow
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Run a controlled pilot that bundles 'observability credits' (time-limited ingestion and retention units) with an optional Compliance Escrow add-on. The escrow is a contractual assurance that activates a deeper compliance review and storage guarantees when a customer selects stricter controls. Goal: measure willingness-to-pay for flexible retention, evaluate legal/ops burden of conditional compliance clauses, and validate UI/contract flows needed for enterprise procurement.
acceptance_criteria: Design and legal sign-off on a one-page Compliance Escrow term that can be appended to enterprise contracts
Console flow for selecting credit tiers + escrow option implemented behind a feature flag
Telemetry pipeline emits per-account 'credit-tier' and 'escrow-enabled' signals to experiments dashboard
Pilot onboarded with 3 existing mid-market accounts via SEs and 10 self-serve trials within 4 weeks
Measurable baseline metrics (conversion, ABR to paid add-on, support ops cost) captured in experiment dashboard
rollout_plan: Week 0: PRD + legal appendix drafted; engineering scoping meeting
Week 1: Build console flag + UI mock; simple API change to accept 'credits_tier' and 'compliance_escrow' on signup
Week 2: Instrument billing pipeline and experimentation tags; create experiment dashboard in Looker/Metabase
Week 3: Soft-launch to 3 invited accounts via SEs; monitor support & contract turnaround
Week 4: Open opt-in to self-serve customers; collect qualitative feedback from procurement teams
Week 6: Review results and decide on productization vs iterate
metrics: Activation: percent of invited accounts that accept Credit Tier + Escrow
Monetization: ARPA delta from customers that opt into escrow vs matched controls
Sales friction: median contract review time (days) when escrow selected
Support load: # of support tickets and average handling time related to escrow onboarding
Operational cost: infra storage delta for extended retention (USD/month) per account
stakeholders: Sanjay Rao (Solutions Engineering) - customer pilot coordination
dependencies: ENG-51781 (billing: support for per-account credit tiers)
ENG-52009 (telemetry: expose escrow flag in events stream)
notes: Escrow concept is intentionally lightweight: not a full escrow service, but a contractual clause and operational checklist that triggers tighter storage and audit guarantees.
Trade-off: higher contractual burden for Sales/Legal vs ability to capture price-sensitive enterprise customers.
If pilot customers request, prepare data transfer & encryption appendix for on-prem/offline intake.
Consider offering a refundable 'escrow deposit' later if customers require financial assurances (out of scope for initial pilot).
